//: OpenLane2 config for lg-npu top-level (sky130A).
Source RTL is SystemVerilog and is read directly via Synlig.
Run `make asic-sky130-prep` to restage src/rtl/*.sv before flow.
Skip OpenLane's Verilator lint step - we already lint RTL via
`make lint` upstream, and Verilator chokes on the auto-generated
Sky130 stdcell UDP blackboxes (e.g. udp_pwrgood_pp$PG).
Floorplan - sized to host 14 SRAM macros (2 wt + 4 act + 8 psum)
in a 4-col x 4-row grid along the bottom of the die, with the
stdcell logic + top-level PDN straps filling the area above.
Refine once first run gives real area.
Power distribution network - top-level stripes on met4/met5.
Macros: OpenRAM-generated sky130 SRAMs.
Download asic/openlane2/macros/ via `make asic-sky130-macros`.
Only the 2 KB 32x512 variant ships pre-built; larger buffers tile.
Sign-off gates.
Threading knobs for parallel-capable stages (tune per host).
STA - typical+slow corners, plus a margin on top of CLOCK_PERIOD.
Synthesis - keep hierarchy until early floorplan to aid debug.
Resets and async paths - false-path handled in BASE_SDC_FILE.
Single clock domain so no async groups.
